suggestion.topic: Mastering the System Design Interview: Framework for Any Distributed Problem
suggestion.rationale: Candidates fail system design interviews not due to lack of technical knowledge, but due to chaotic, unstructured problem-solving approaches.
suggestion.hook_angle: Panicking during system design interviews? Here is the exact 4-step framework senior engineers use to ace scale, bottlenecks, and back-of-the-envelope math.
